title: Data and code for A Digital Phenotype for Cauliflower Curd Compactness Integrating Sectional Gap and Color Signals
description: Frozen data, saved predictions, image and mechanical-result provenance, and analysis code for an operational two-dimensional longitudinal-section phenotype calibrated to a GR/DD mechanical composite. The F2 cohort comprises 220 training and 55 historical test records. The advanced-inbred application comprises 222 retained records with a separately preserved 230-record archive. Available images and unresolved linkages are identified in manifests. These data do not establish independent anatomical accuracy or cross-environment predictive validation. The original 198 advanced-inbred images are not included at the author’s instruction; their numerical and linkage metadata are retained. No alternative access route has been specified.
image_sharing_scope: 275 F2 originals included; 198 advanced-inbred originals excluded by author instruction; numerical and linkage records retained
